svg.title: PCA roadmap
svg.desc: Steps from loading data to graphing PC1 against PC2, with the variable passed between each step, the original data kept for adding the components back, and a panel showing how PCA finds PC1 and PC2 and scores each row.
svg.text: PCA roadmap: how the code blocks connect
Each box is a code block. The label on each arrow is the variable handed to the next block.
